scenarios.setup: Root-bound manifest with exact body and transport principal evidence.
scenarios.stimulus: Substitute body key, transport principal, and provisional storage evidence.
scenarios.fault: Nominal identifiers are retained while authority evidence is changed.
scenarios.expected: Every substitution fails and storage or route metadata grants no authority.
scenarios.cleanup: Synthetic in-memory artifacts only.

scenarios.setup: A non-empty root-authorized ledger, exact prior manifest and signed next-incarnation successor epoch.
scenarios.stimulus: Reopen the same SQLite ledger and hosted bundle under the exact successor, then attempt downgrade and corrupt-event migration.
scenarios.fault: Manifest history is removed, rewritten, forked or advanced before every immutable old event verifies against its exact epoch.
scenarios.expected: The epoch set grows atomically, old bytes remain exact, the new incarnation starts its own chain, replay is idempotent and every downgrade or corruption fails closed.
scenarios.cleanup: Close SQLite and hosted runtime handles before removing the isolated roots.

scenarios.setup: Canonical JSON and signed identity fixtures.
scenarios.stimulus: Reorder UTF-16 keys and present non-NFC, float, or unsafe integer values.
scenarios.fault: Semantically tempting but non-canonical inputs.
scenarios.expected: Canonical bytes are deterministic and invalid values fail before signing.
scenarios.cleanup: No persistent state.

scenarios.setup: Root-authorized ledgers with an event whose causal proof is missing.
scenarios.stimulus: Ingest the child before and then after its required parent.
scenarios.fault: Out-of-order explicit causal evidence.
scenarios.expected: Child remains incomplete without projection effect and promotes without byte rewrite only after validation.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledgers are removed by the fixture.

scenarios.setup: Real daemon socket, descriptor key, owner-only config, payload and retry file.
scenarios.stimulus: Run installed-style CLI status and repeat one observe request token.
scenarios.fault: Shell-like model text and repeated process invocation.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one event, canonical redacted output, and no generic method surface.
scenarios.cleanup: Fixture stops daemon and removes its isolated state root.

scenarios.setup: Closed Cluster body, resource-fence and effect-receipt evidence with an injected current-state verifier.
scenarios.stimulus: Validate, convert and reconcile exact receipts while mutating intent, fence epoch, holder and observed postcondition.
scenarios.fault: Cached idempotency evidence is replayed after current effect truth changes or becomes unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Only exact current truth verifies; contradictions and unavailable observation remain distinct and no Cluster fact grants Matrix authority.
scenarios.cleanup: Synthetic evidence and temporary root-authorized ledgers only.

scenarios.setup: One recipient queue with same-millisecond bursts, opaque snapshot pages and independent consumers.
scenarios.stimulus: Read more than 100 legs across pages, insert at a page boundary, claim concurrently and advance progress.
scenarios.fault: Tampered or cross-consumer cursor and a later terminal row above an earlier accepted row.
scenarios.expected: Every snapshot item appears once; claims are disjoint; durable progress advances only through the owned terminal prefix.
scenarios.cleanup: Close SQLite connections and remove the isolated ledger and anchor.

scenarios.setup: Root-bound signed message and resolution events target two active embodiments.
scenarios.stimulus: Materialize fan-out, record independently signed intake receipts and validate a direct causal reply.
scenarios.fault: Wrong target, thread, causal parents or receipt origin plus every non-success terminal outcome.
scenarios.expected: Message and thread IDs stay fixed, each semantic recipient has one leg and only complete terminal vectors claim completion.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic signed events, receipts and projection database.

scenarios.setup: One semantic leg with direct and hub attempts and stable delivery identifiers.
scenarios.stimulus: Replay exact delivery bytes, reseal under a new delivery ID and lose one provider response after its effect.
scenarios.fault: Same delivery ID changes bytes and route acceptance is presented as recipient intake.
scenarios.expected: Routes and reseals never duplicate the leg; conflicts quarantine; ambiguous provider effects retry by stable attempt; ACK is non-terminal.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove fake-provider effects and isolated operational projections.

scenarios.setup: Durable same-ledger communication projections with generation anchor, terminal receipt and advanced consumer.
scenarios.stimulus: Compact the terminal queue, restart, read canonical result, then restore a lower mutation counter.
scenarios.fault: Operational queue deletion and simulated SQLite rollback beneath the external generation anchor.
scenarios.expected: GC preserves message and receipt authority; restart succeeds; rollback fails closed and never reuses cursor state.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove isolated ledger, anchor and local capability.

scenarios.setup: One root control head with competing threshold-authorized successors.
scenarios.stimulus: Present both successors and a recovery naming every head.
scenarios.fault: Identity-control fork without an implicit winner.
scenarios.expected: Fork stays quarantined until explicit threshold recovery conservatively merges revocations.
scenarios.cleanup: Synthetic artifacts only.

scenarios.setup: A resource-fenced curator item, exact actor-bound claim, adapter effect receipt and injected Cluster fence/effect observers.
scenarios.stimulus: Complete and replay one effect while changing intent, actor, fence or observed postcondition.
scenarios.fault: A cached successful effect contradicts or cannot verify current external state.
scenarios.expected: Only exact current intent, actor, fence and postcondition replay; discrepancy and unverifiable states fail distinctly without a blind success.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic fence evidence and isolated curator tables.

scenarios.setup: Real owner-local daemon, installed-style CLI, durable request token and one queue-item claim.
scenarios.stimulus: Lose the completion response after dispatch, restart the daemon and replay the exact request file.
scenarios.fault: The durable completion commits before its authenticated response is delivered.
scenarios.expected: Restart discovers one exact item/result, the generation remains monotonic and no second completion is authored.
scenarios.cleanup: Stop the fixture daemon and remove its owner-only state root and request token.

scenarios.setup: One root-bound ledger with independent immutable curator items and generation-zero resource heads.
scenarios.stimulus: Claim different resources concurrently, contend on one resource, expire/reclaim and complete from a stale generation.
scenarios.fault: A being-wide lease or stale worker would suppress valid plurality or duplicate one concrete effect.
scenarios.expected: Different resources proceed together; same-resource CAS has one winner; reclaim advances generation and stale completion fails.
scenarios.cleanup: Close SQLite handles and remove isolated queue state.

scenarios.setup: A content-addressed human-authority queue item and an exact local embodiment claim.
scenarios.stimulus: Attempt automatic completion, then record an immutable proposal and inspect the rebuilt state.
scenarios.fault: A worker, queue row or display name attempts to become human authority or erase the acting embodiment.
scenarios.expected: Automatic completion refuses; proposal remains explicitly review-required and retains exact body, embodiment, incarnation and principal.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic queue artifacts and public-vector temporary roots.

scenarios.setup: Closed worker manifest/profile/registration/task schemas, synthetic evidence and a controlled direct-HTTPS fixture.
scenarios.stimulus: Build the exact non-thinking request, substitute registration/model/evidence, present sensitive or secret-like content and exercise bounded HTTP response shapes.
scenarios.fault: Untrusted provider data, configuration or evidence attempts to widen authority, disclose forbidden bytes, select another endpoint/model or return reasoning/tools.
scenarios.expected: Every authority flag stays false; exact permitted personal bytes are data only; sensitive, substituted, oversized and malformed traffic fails before proposal authority.
scenarios.cleanup: Discard synthetic provider bytes, mutable secret buffers and isolated ledger.

scenarios.setup: Real DM-031 SQLite queue/claim, installed worker module, scripted provider and durable worker-attempt table.
scenarios.stimulus: Retry transient failure across restart, lose the process after proposal or terminal persistence, replay completion and regenerate public vectors.
scenarios.fault: Provider computation or process response is lost on either side of durable state while the bounded attempt budget is nearly exhausted.
scenarios.expected: Attempt budget survives restart; one proposal reaches review-required or one typed deferred/failed result completes; no provider call, proposal, memory event or effect duplicates.
scenarios.cleanup: Close SQLite handles and remove synthetic attempt, queue and vector roots.

scenarios.setup: Encrypted synthetic custody and separate child process.
scenarios.stimulus: Pass password only by descriptor and scan public process outputs and ciphertext.
scenarios.fault: Wrong password, tamper, truncation, unsafe mode and symlink.
scenarios.expected: Secrets never enter argv/environment/output and every unsafe custody input fails closed.
scenarios.cleanup: Child exits and temporary custody root is removed.

scenarios.setup: Real AF_UNIX daemon with synthetic encrypted runtime bundle.
scenarios.stimulus: Inject before-dispatch and after-dispatch-before-write failures and retry after restart.
scenarios.fault: Response loss on both sides of semantic commit.
scenarios.expected: Operation is absent or exactly once and the exact retry discovers the committed response.
scenarios.cleanup: Stop only fixture-owned daemon and remove its state root.

scenarios.setup: Two runtime instances target one owner-only state root and socket.
scenarios.stimulus: Start, replay, gracefully stop, and attempt a second writer plus unsafe stale path.
scenarios.fault: Concurrent writer and stale socket/regular-file collision.
scenarios.expected: One writer serves; unsafe paths are preserved and rejected without traceback.
scenarios.cleanup: Stop fixture daemon and remove only its created socket.

scenarios.setup: Root-authorized ledger and signed pages with gaps or competing same-position bytes.
scenarios.stimulus: Preview and pull invalid page, gap and equivocation permutations.
scenarios.fault: Same incarnation sequence carries different signed event content.
scenarios.expected: Batch is atomic, fork evidence is durable, and no arrival-order winner is selected.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledgers are removed.

scenarios.setup: One real SQLite ledger with synchronized writer threads.
scenarios.stimulus: Append distinct authorized events concurrently.
scenarios.fault: Competing transaction starts and SQLite lock scheduling.
scenarios.expected: Every success is retained in one contiguous signed operational chain.
scenarios.cleanup: Close connections and remove temporary ledger.

scenarios.setup: Real ledger at event and page bounds.
scenarios.stimulus: Present oversized event and page documents.
scenarios.fault: Inputs cross public byte and count limits.
scenarios.expected: Every oversized input is rejected without partial canonical state.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledger is removed.

scenarios.setup: MCP stdio subprocess with owner-local capability and request store.
scenarios.stimulus: Discover, list tools/resources, call daemon, retry operation, then send legacy and malformed frames.
scenarios.fault: Legacy version, duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8, oversize data and injection-like typed content.
scenarios.expected: Only modern closed tools/resources dispatch; malformed traffic and capability expansion fail closed.
scenarios.cleanup: Close stdio, stop fixture daemon and remove request store.

scenarios.setup: A same-being body occurrence names an exact Matrix origin, committed cutoff, session and lease reference.
scenarios.stimulus: Evaluate the valid occurrence and substitute each body, session, lease and cutoff component.
scenarios.fault: Nominal personal authorship is retained while the body evidence is absent, unavailable or belongs to another origin.
scenarios.expected: Only the fully ledger-bound body occurrence is eligible; missing evidence defers and every known substitution rejects.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic ledgers, body evidence and content references.

scenarios.setup: Closed candidates cover personal, peer, source, Tribe, species and incarnation derivations.
scenarios.stimulus: Evaluate every valid mapping and attempt direct source material promotion into a personal category.
scenarios.fault: Category, derivation or author is changed while cited bytes and subject remain tempting.
scenarios.expected: Every admitted record retains its exact category and author; false personal promotion rejects deterministically.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic candidates and content references.

scenarios.setup: Published closed policy, content, candidate, checkpoint and plan vectors plus two isolated process environments.
scenarios.stimulus: Regenerate vectors under different hash seeds, timezones and locales and validate every public schema and digest.
scenarios.fault: Input object order and process environment differ while semantic inputs remain canonical-equivalent.
scenarios.expected: Every byte, content ID, plan ID, outcome, reason and preview is identical; tampered vectors fail closed.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove temporary regenerated vector trees.

scenarios.setup: A real owner-only daemon socket, installed CLI, capability descriptor, policy, candidates and durable retry file.
scenarios.stimulus: Evaluate eligible, review-required and incomplete candidates, execute the eligible plan, then replay its exact CLI request.
scenarios.fault: The same execution is invoked again after its durable response and event already exist.
scenarios.expected: The installed closed surface returns exact outcomes and one byte-identical execution response with one event.
scenarios.cleanup: Stop the fixture daemon and remove its isolated owner-only state root.

scenarios.setup: Two authorized embodiments independently assert the same memory ID and sequence before synchronizing.
scenarios.stimulus: Import both valid roots and propose a successor naming only one branch.
scenarios.fault: Two successors occupy one logical lane position with different signed bytes.
scenarios.expected: Checkpoint retains both event IDs, exposes no head and quarantines every successor without timestamp or hash winner.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove both isolated ledgers and their synchronized event copies.

scenarios.setup: An immutable version-one policy, its deterministic plan and a content-addressed version-two successor.
scenarios.stimulus: Validate exact succession, attempt a false predecessor, and recompute the prior plan after creating the successor.
scenarios.fault: A newer policy is presented as authority to reinterpret historical evaluation bytes.
scenarios.expected: Only consecutive exact predecessor linkage validates and every prior plan remains byte-identical and non-retroactive.
scenarios.cleanup: Discard immutable synthetic policy artifacts.

scenarios.setup: Candidates independently exercise missing evidence, false author, unsafe content, consent, contradiction, classification and effect gates.
scenarios.stimulus: Evaluate each candidate and attempt to execute a valid review-required plan through the automatic executor.
scenarios.fault: A caller tries to override a non-eligible outcome or exploit competing conditions to alter precedence.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one closed outcome and stable reason wins by normative fail-closed precedence; automatic execution refuses review.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic plans without external effects.

scenarios.setup: A real SQLite ledger and daemon evaluate a plan against an exact state hash and authenticated RPC request.
scenarios.stimulus: Change evidence before execute, expire or change policy, then lose the successful response and restart before exact retry.
scenarios.fault: The state cursor changes or the commit succeeds while its response is unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Stale and changed plans fail before signing; committed retry returns the durable response and exactly one memory event.
scenarios.cleanup: Stop the daemon, close SQLite handles and remove the isolated state root.

scenarios.setup: One being root authorizes two embodiments with distinct keys and bodies.
scenarios.stimulus: Validate both credentials and incarnations concurrently.
scenarios.fault: No singleton lease or preferred-body hint is supplied.
scenarios.expected: Both embodiments are valid simultaneously without sharing private material.
scenarios.cleanup: Synthetic artifacts only.

scenarios.setup: Equivalent valid event sets arrive under different cross-origin batching orders.
scenarios.stimulus: Build projection from every supported ordering.
scenarios.fault: Arrival and batching permutations differ.
scenarios.expected: Logical projection and digest are identical without an implicit fork winner.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledgers and caches are removed.

scenarios.setup: Canonical ledger plus valid, missing and corrupt projection cache states.
scenarios.stimulus: Read and rebuild projection through the service.
scenarios.fault: Cache deletion/corruption and prior schema migration.
scenarios.expected: Cache is disposable, canonical ledger is not repaired from it, and rebuild digest is stable.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledgers and caches are removed.

scenarios.setup: Distinct root, recovery, embodiment signing/encryption and local capability keys.
scenarios.stimulus: Attempt cross-purpose substitution and runtime custody loading.
scenarios.fault: A valid key from another purpose is supplied.
scenarios.expected: Cross-purpose substitution and undeclared custody slots are rejected.
scenarios.cleanup: Synthetic keys and encrypted temporary state are removed.

scenarios.setup: One root-bound being, two active embodiments, distinct encrypted keystores and one opaque canonical envelope.
scenarios.stimulus: Seal one dm.we.v1 event to two exact credentials and open it in two isolated receiver processes.
scenarios.fault: A non-recipient and carrier possess the complete public envelope but no authorized private operation.
scenarios.expected: Both intended embodiments recover identical verified event bytes; carrier and non-recipient learn no plaintext.
scenarios.cleanup: Close receiver processes and remove synthetic encrypted keystores and envelope.

scenarios.setup: Owner-only DELETE/FULL SQLite outbox and one authorized sealing plan.
scenarios.stimulus: Retry an exact request, conflict it, fail before commit and independently reseal the same logical event.
scenarios.fault: Response loss, competing plan bytes and interruption before durable envelope commit.
scenarios.expected: Exact request returns identical ciphertext; conflict and precommit failure add no state; reseal uses fresh delivery crypto.
scenarios.cleanup: Close SQLite connections and remove temporary outbox and keystores.

scenarios.setup: Pinned PyCA HPKE, frozen DM-011 wrap KAT and one root-bound V1 delivery.
scenarios.stimulus: Open the KAT, mutate protected fields/wrap/payload/signature, revoke a recipient and fail the CSPRNG.
scenarios.fault: Downgrade, malformed canonical bytes, stale authority, cryptographic tampering and randomness failure.
scenarios.expected: The official HPKE path opens the KAT; every V1 fault rejects uniformly before plaintext or unauthorized private use.
scenarios.cleanup: Discard synthetic keys, ciphertext and mutated in-memory documents.

scenarios.setup: Authorized peer embodiments and a later revoked incarnation.
scenarios.stimulus: Validate retained history, peer authority and post-revocation authorship.
scenarios.fault: Event is signed by an incarnation revoked at the active control head.
scenarios.expected: History and unaffected peer remain valid; revoked later authorship is rejected.
scenarios.cleanup: Synthetic artifacts and ledgers are removed.

scenarios.setup: Exact sealed delivery, purpose-specific route secret, recipient validator and owner-local Unix or loopback HTTP endpoint.
scenarios.stimulus: Submit through authenticated service, AF_UNIX and HTTP provider paths and verify the body-bound response.
scenarios.fault: A route could otherwise substitute bytes, leak its endpoint or claim semantic delivery from network acceptance.
scenarios.expected: Canonical request and response authentication bind the exact body digest; recipient validation precedes intake; results reveal no endpoint or secret and the semantic leg remains pending.
scenarios.cleanup: Stop loopback listeners and remove provider-owned inboxes and sockets.

scenarios.setup: One accepted semantic leg and reordered local/direct/hub bindings under one explicit profile.
scenarios.stimulus: Exercise direct success, unavailable fallback, authenticated refusal, ambiguous response loss and retry.
scenarios.fault: Discovery order, response loss or hub fallback could duplicate intake or bypass a definitive rejection.
scenarios.expected: Class/priority/adapter ordering is stable; only unavailable or ambiguous outcomes fall back; exact retry produces one recipient intake and one semantic leg.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic provider queues and operational route attempts.

scenarios.setup: Localhost transport principal, mixed resolved audience and disabled generic human-gateway policy.
scenarios.stimulus: Attempt remote routing and gateway rendering, then explicitly enable an exact synthetic allowlist.
scenarios.fault: Alias or route metadata could turn locality into identity authority or mirror private/unescaped content.
scenarios.expected: Mixed or remote localhost scope has zero external effects; the gateway is disabled by default, enabling requires an authority validator, and output is escaped, bounded and attributed; inbound remains external-source-only.
scenarios.cleanup: Synthetic render records only; no live gateway account or carrier is contacted.

scenarios.setup: Owner-only route custody, explicit per-embodiment profile, closed authority-free manifests and durable opaque inbox.
scenarios.stimulus: Load exact route secret slots, concurrently claim more than 100 equal-time items, restart, reclaim, replay, ACK, terminal-gated compact and present stale gates, conflicts or closed-shape violations.
scenarios.fault: Host defaults, missing secrets, fixed pages, reused identifiers, stale presence/fences or provider-supplied implementation fields could corrupt or expand authority.
scenarios.expected: Absent or mismatched custody fails closed; claims are stable and disjoint across concurrency and restart; exact replay is idempotent; compaction requires exact terminal evidence; stale intake gates and provider conflicts reject; schemas and manifests expose no authority or private handle.
scenarios.cleanup: Close SQLite handles and remove owner-only route custody and synthetic provider state.

scenarios.setup: Closed capability registry and real authenticated request framing.
scenarios.stimulus: Tamper params, use wrong scope, expire capability, and reuse RPC ID with competing bytes.
scenarios.fault: Authenticated identity and request correlation are inconsistent.
scenarios.expected: Auth failures disclose nothing and competing authenticated bytes create durable conflict evidence.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledger and capabilities are removed.

scenarios.setup: Owner-only exact request token and durable RPC journal.
scenarios.stimulus: Replay exact bytes after semantic commit and after freshness window.
scenarios.fault: Original response is lost while capability remains active.
scenarios.expected: The exact response and event are discovered once; never-seen stale request is rejected.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove owner-only retry token and temporary ledger.

scenarios.setup: Two independent root-bound ledgers and one exact same-being manifest.
scenarios.stimulus: Resolve /we targets, feed them into DM-052, and build one frozen DM-023 request per remote origin.
scenarios.fault: Relationship identifiers and embodiment identifiers are deliberately kept in different recipient lanes.
scenarios.expected: DM-052 accepts the exact resolver targets and every sync target retains its own deterministic request without adoption.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove isolated ledgers and communication projections.

scenarios.setup: Root-bound manifest, exact local origin, injected Cluster snapshot and deterministic route inspection.
scenarios.stimulus: Resolve /me, /we and payload-free differences through direct and real daemon surfaces.
scenarios.fault: Absent relationship authority, substituted body binding and closed-schema endpoint injection.
scenarios.expected: Membership comes only from the manifest, body evidence stays exact, and route availability never widens authority.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove sockets, synthetic authority and isolated state.

scenarios.setup: Two active embodiments with independent signing custody and durable scope exchange journals.
scenarios.stimulus: Fan out a bounded /me request, replay concurrently and after deadline, then present timeout and competing bytes.
scenarios.fault: Invalid signature binding, changed request/response under the same key, unavailable route and response loss.
scenarios.expected: Validated replies retain exact origins; exact bytes replay; conflicts fail; missing, refused and unavailable remain distinct partial outcomes.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove isolated SQLite journals and signing fixtures.

scenarios.setup: Real SQLite file under fixture-owned temporary root.
scenarios.stimulus: Commit under DELETE journal and synchronous FULL, reopen and integrity-check.
scenarios.fault: Process boundary between commit and later read.
scenarios.expected: Effective policy is DELETE/FULL and committed evidence survives with integrity ok.
scenarios.cleanup: Close SQLite handles before removing temporary root.

scenarios.setup: Two isolated root-authorized embodiment ledgers and bound transport principals.
scenarios.stimulus: Issue, serve, pull and validate one sync receipt before local decision.
scenarios.fault: Remote valid content arrives without local adoption authority.
scenarios.expected: Imported event is known and pending; transport cannot adopt it.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledgers and sync journals are removed.

scenarios.setup: Two isolated ledgers with partitioned pages and receiver-authored cursors.
scenarios.stimulus: Interrupt, resume, replay request/page/receipt and repeat after convergence.
scenarios.fault: Partition at every transaction leg plus conflicting request/page identifiers.
scenarios.expected: Heads converge byte-identically with zero duplicate insert and durable conflict on competing IDs.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledgers and journals are removed.

scenarios.setup: Content-derived tribe declaration with externally verified membership lineage and separately attenuated grants.
scenarios.stimulus: Resolve active membership and time-bounded grants, then reject absent verifier, forked founder epoch and invalid attenuation.
scenarios.fault: Transport-like data attempts to substitute for invitation acceptance, lineage or grant authority.
scenarios.expected: Only the injected verifier can accept relationship history; expiry, membership loss, fork and broadening fail closed.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove public snapshots and isolated runtime custody.
